title: The Complete History of Rome: Every Year on the Map
description:
Witness the epic 2,000-year saga of Rome, from its humble beginnings as a small republic to its mastery of the Mediterranean, the imperial golden age, and the ultimate survival and fall of the Byzantine Empire in Constantinople. Using detailed animated maps, this documentary covers every major war, expansion, crisis, and rebirth across two millennia of Western history.

Chapters include the Birth of Rome, the Punic Wars against Carthage, Julius Caesar and Augustus, the Crisis of the Third Century, Justinian's Dream, the Crusades, and the final fall of Constantinople.

#Rome #History #Documentary #ByzantineEmpire #AncientRome
